summary.intent: Fix the memory loop TUI injection tab so it tests against all active memories and shows clear inject/skip status instead of raw scores. Then remove the skill, insights, improve, and permissions commands, keeping only summary and memory-loop.
summary.outcome: The injection tab was updated to use PreviewSelection() returning a full SelectionReport with INJECT/SKIP labels and skip reasons. Two new render tests were added and all 22 tests passed. The removal of the four commands was planned but not yet executed — the session ended at the planning stage.

repo: PreviewSelection() returns a SelectionReport with both Matches and Skipped fields; SelectRelevant() only returns matches — use PreviewSelection when you need the full picture
The memorylooptui package has a testPromptResultMsg type in messages.go that carries prompt test results between the root model and the injection tab
explanatory_insights.go is a hook handler, not a command — it should not be removed with the command cleanup
The skilldb, skilltui, permissions, and insights directories are candidates for removal when pruning to summary + memory-loop

code.finding: testPromptResultMsg was changed to carry a full SelectionReport instead of just a slice of matches

Tests set activeTab but call injectionTab.view() directly — unusedwrite lint fires if activeTab assignment is kept; removed those assignments to fix lint
This file is a hook handler not a command; must be kept even when removing the insights command
